basis: Inherited plasma-protein metabolic disorder; no additional organ damage applies across this heterogeneous group.
Carcinoma arising in the Bartholin gland, a reproductive organ outside the axes.
Diffuse intraductal papillomatosis is a breast duct neoplasm; breast has no axis.
Skin cornification disease from steroid-sulfatase deficiency; ADHD occurs in 30-79%. Corneal opacities are usually non-impairing; intellectual disability is uncommon.
B-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma is a hematopoietic malignancy; the lymphoma designation also warrants the immune mechanism axis.
Adipocytic soft-tissue sarcoma, typically arising in deep connective tissues of the extremities; superficial skin involvement is not characteristic across cases.
FMN2-related neurodevelopmental disorder; developmental delay and intellectual disability in 5/5. Mitral valve prolapse in 1/5 does not meet threshold.
Autoimmune superficial blistering skin disease. Oral ulcers occur in only 5-29%; associated systemic lupus is a separate disease.
Cerebrovascular ischemic disease causing infarction of brainstem tissue.
Ectodermal appendage disorder with defining sensorineural deafness; no evidence establishes other common organ damage.
Mitochondrial respiratory-chain defect; gliosis, dystonia and abnormal brain structure in 1/1 annotated patient support neurologic damage. Cardiac frequency is unknown.
Mature T/NK-cell hematopoietic malignancy and lymphoma; skin, liver and other extranodal sites vary across subtypes.
Neurologic sensorimotor disorder; the urge to move the legs does not establish skeletal-muscle damage.
Confined thymic epithelial tumor; thymus has no anatomical axis here. Associated autoimmune or immunodeficiency syndromes are separate diseases.
Craniosynostosis and limb malformations define the syndrome; ptosis occurs in 80-99%, and tracheal cartilaginous sleeve in 20/20 annotated patients.
Primary ovarian failure entails loss of gonadal endocrine function, beyond isolated infertility.
Inherited hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, with possible ventricular noncompaction, directly affects myocardium.
Defining neurodevelopmental disorder; ocular dysfunction, including strabismus and refractive abnormalities, affects roughly half or more. Hypotonia alone adds no muscle axis.
Focal epilepsy arising from an acquired structural brain abnormality; its varied underlying causes do not establish another shared organ axis.
Isolated developmental eye malformation caused by GDF3 variants; microphthalmia documented in 2/3 patients.
Multivitamin transport defect with infantile neurodegeneration; reduced IgG in 2/2 supports humoral immune dysfunction. Nystagmus alone does not establish eye damage.
Fungal infection directly involving and damaging the nail.
Neoplasm arising in eccrine sweat glands, which are skin appendages.
Inherited skeletal-muscle channelopathies causing episodic paralysis; potassium disturbances characterize common subtypes. Neuropathy and cardiac disease are subtype-specific.
Combined immune deficiency with defining severe malabsorption; protracted diarrhea occurs in 30-79%. Respiratory infections and infectious hepatobiliary diseases are separately coded.
